newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Belgium, Luxembourg in Hong Kong investments pact.
newsitem.headline: Belgium, Luxembourg in Hong Kong investments pact.

text.p: Luxembourg and Belgium have jointly agreed with Hong Kong on an accord to protect and promote mutual investments, the Luxembourg finance ministry said.
The pact is to encourage investment between the Luxembourg and Belgium economic and monetary union and Hong Kong by reinforcing the legal protection of investments, it said.
"It is a sign of confidence in the future of Hong Kong" which is to return to Chinese rule on June 30, 1997, it said.

The accord will be formally signed on October 7 in Brussels by Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt and, later in the day in Luxembourg, by Luxembourg's Budget Minister Marc Fischbach, and Donald Tsang, financial secretary to the Hong Kong government.
Tsang is on a two day trip to the Benelux countries to meet senior European Commission officials as well as Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker.
